messages:
mason: Heads up — canary for model-serve 3.2.1 just failed in eu1 due to a transitive dependency bump in image-builder. build logs show missing symbol in libfastkv. Need a fast approval to pin image and skip full canary for eu1 only.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: model-serve:v3.2.1 (canary) -> eu1 (10% traffic)
Status: FAILED (healthcheck 502)
Logs: 
```
ERROR: cannot load symbol syncKV from libfastkv.so.1.4.2
Trace: dlopen libfastkv.so.1.4.2: No such file or directory
```

jen_ops: Oof. Any impact on other regions?

mason: Staging and us-west are green. Problem reproduced only on eu1 images (we build a separate image pipeline there because of custom packaging). The bump happened in the private package mirror yesterday.

devon_sre: E2E failing in eu1 for kv-backed inference paths. Error rate up ~6% on canary. We can mitigate by pinning the image to `model-serve:v3.2.0-eu1-frozen` which we validated last week. Rollback plan: revert traffic to stable (v3.2.0) and redeploy v3.2.1 after rebuilding image without the bump.

leah_product: Is there any customer-facing degradation? Any SLA hits?

devon_sre: No SLA breaches yet, small error spike internal to some batch flows. No escalations.

mike_releasebot: NOTE: This is a fast-window request outside the planned change window (current window 02:00–04:00 UTC). Requesting expedited approval from on-call + release leads. Please vote `+1` or `-1`.

mason: Proposed action: skip full canary for eu1, apply image pin `model-serve:v3.2.0-eu1-frozen` to eu1 nodes, hold traffic at 0% for v3.2.1 in eu1, and run a controlled smoke for 1 hour. If smoke passes, we can resume normal rollout. Command I will run after approvals: 
```
# pin image on eu1 nodes
kubectl -n prod set image ds/model-serve model-serve=model-serve:v3.2.0-eu1-frozen --context=eu1
# pause rollout for other regions
deployctl pause rollout --service model-serve --regions eu1
```

jen_ops: Important to include a short rollback trigger: if 5xx rate > 1% sustained for 10m, immediate revert to v3.2.0 and page SRE.

leah_product: I can approve for eu1 limited change only. We need release notes update: add entry "Hotfix: Pin eu1 image due to packaging dependency issue."

mike_releasebot: +1 (release lead) — expedite ok for eu1 only, ensure postmortem.

devon_sre: +1 from SRE on-call, will monitor and be ready to revert.

jen_ops: +1 from ops if mason runs the exact commands and shares the rollout watch output. Also add a temporary alert: `eu1.modelserve.5xx > 0.01 for 10m` -> page.

mason: Running the pin now, will paste watch output.

deploy-bot: Action: set image -> model-serve:v3.2.0-eu1-frozen applied to ds/model-serve in eu1. Rollout status: 3/3 updated, 0 unavailable.

mason: Smoke checks: 
- /health -> 200
- small inference sample -> ok
- daily batch job start -> queued (no failures in first 5m)

mike_releasebot: Updating release notes draft: 
"Hotfix: Pin eu1 model-serve image to v3.2.0-eu1-frozen to mitigate packaging dependency regression affecting canaries. Actioned under expedited approval window."

leah_product: Adding note to customer-facing changelog is fine. Keep us posted if anything changes.

devon_sre: Monitoring for 30m. If no regressions, we merge this into release history and schedule a rebuild of the eu1 image with the fixed package next run.

mason: 30m smoke passed. No increase in 5xx. Leaving temporary alert in place for 24h.

mike_releasebot: Marking thread as resolved for expedited approval: decision=pin-eu1-image, scope=eu1-only, postmortem=required. :white_check_mark:

mason: Thanks team. Will open postmortem ticket with logs and build timeline.
